name: Raging Hunger makes Pooled Vitality generate 3 Rage (#601)
contract: Raging Hunger 681336 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 0) and BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30, over EffectSpellClassMask (536870912, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 29 = Pooled Vitality 680687 and Running Wild 800175. Pooled Vitality's effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE (30) with MiscValue 1 (POWER_RAGE) and value 0, so it becomes 30 raw; Rage is stored at ten times the displayed value, so that is 3 Rage. Pooled Vitality is cast on the player as a triggered spell by AscensionBloodmageVitality.cpp, and effect values still pass through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers for a triggered cast. Tooltip: "Triggering Pooled Vitality now also generates $/10;s1 Rage." Regression guard for native behaviour.

Raging Hunger sets Pooled Vitality's energize to 30 (3 Rage)
